body: Rebuild committed esbuild bundles (`npm run build`), document `AGB_DISABLE_ORCHESTRATOR` and `AGB_TEST_PASSWD_HOME` in `website/env-docs.json`, regenerate `website/generated/*.mdx` (`node website/scripts/gen-reference.mjs`), and add a non-mutating `mkdtempSync` `esbuild` bundle-freshness test for `dist/hooks/pre-tool-use.bundle.mjs` in `test/plugin-layout.test.mjs`.
title: Rebuild dist bundles, sync website generated reference docs, and add hook bundle freshness check
